Check the Laplace/Wald approximation against NUTS

Source: R/interop.R
check_laplace.Rd

Samples the fitted objective (see frm_sample()) and compares the ML estimates and sdreport standard errors against posterior means and SDs. Close agreement supports the Laplace approximation and Wald intervals; a posterior SD much larger than the Wald SE, or a shifted mean, flags parameters where they are unreliable (typically variance components with few groups).

Usage

check_laplace(fit, chains = 2, iter = 1000, ...)

Arguments

fit

A frmtmb_fit.

chains, iter

Passed to frm_sample().

...

Passed to frm_sample().

Value

A data frame (one row per outer parameter) with columns ml, post_mean, wald_se, post_sd, z_shift ((post_mean - ml)/post_sd) and sd_ratio (post_sd/wald_se).
